content: GitHub Wiki has no native multi-language or localization support (official docs on wikis contain no i18n feature; a 2025 community discussion asks for page translations and points to external tools). Project conventions: language-suffixed pages (Home, Home-pt, Home.zh-CN.md), language prefix folders (en/, pt/), or a hub Home page linking to per-language sections; or moving localized docs to a dedicated platform (Wiki.js multilingual namespaces, static site generators on Pages). Implication for a generator targeting GitHub Wiki: output-language support is limited to the page content the generator itself authors (headings, labels, generated index); platform chrome is out of the generator's control.
